response.sql: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(c.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(c.line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(c.line_count - o.avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count FROM category_stats AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.line_count > o.avg_line_count;

assumptions.assumption: A line with an amount of zero has undefined relative overspend and is excluded from that average; it still counts as a budget line.
